```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(VennDiagram)
library(ggvenn)
library(ggbreak)
library(clinfun)
library(ggsignif)
library(ggpubr)
library(rstatix)
library(effsize)

source('~/CRISPR-KO-GuideRefine/GuideRefine_functions.R')
source("./00_CRISPR-KO-library-survey-functions.R")
```

# Bind every library into one single plot

```{r}

avana_library_and_lfc_data <- obtain_required_data("../data/library_data/avana_library.tsv", 
                                                   "../data/sgrna_lfc_data/output_normalized/avana_normalized_lfc.csv", 
                                                   "../data/sgrna_lfc_data/avana_data/avana_stratify_pam_distal_single_mismatch.csv")

tkov3_library_and_lfc_data <- obtain_required_data("../data/library_data/tkov3_guide_sequence.tsv", 
                                                   "../data/sgrna_lfc_data/output_normalized/tkov3_rpe1_normalized_lfc.csv", 
                                                   "../data/sgrna_lfc_data/tkov3_data/tkov3_stratify_pam_distal_single_mismatch.csv")

yusa_library_and_lfc_data <- obtain_required_data("../data/library_data/yusa_hcrispr_ko_grnas.tsv", 
                                                 "../data/sgrna_lfc_data/output_normalized/yusa_normalized_lfc.csv", 
                                                 "../data/sgrna_lfc_data/yusa_data/yusa_stratify_pam_distal_single_mismatch.csv")

brunello_library_and_lfc_data <- obtain_required_data("../data/library_data/broadgpp-brunello-library-contents.tsv", 
                                                     "../data/sgrna_lfc_data/output_normalized/brunello_a375_normalized_lfc.csv", 
                                                     "../data/sgrna_lfc_data/brunello_data/brunello_stratify_pam_distal_single_mismatch.csv")

jacquere_library_and_lfc_data <- obtain_required_data("../data/library_data/Jacquere_PerGuideAnnotations_Quota4.tsv", 
                                                     "../data/sgrna_lfc_data/output_normalized/jacquere_normalized_lfc.csv", 
                                                     "../data/sgrna_lfc_data/jacquere_data/jacquere_stratify_pam_distal_single_mismatch.csv")

avana_library_and_lfc_data[[1]] <- avana_library_and_lfc_data[[1]] %>% mutate(library = "avana") 
tkov3_library_and_lfc_data[[1]] <- tkov3_library_and_lfc_data[[1]] %>% mutate(library = "toronto_v3") 
yusa_library_and_lfc_data[[1]] <- yusa_library_and_lfc_data[[1]] %>% mutate(library = "yusa") 
brunello_library_and_lfc_data[[1]] <- brunello_library_and_lfc_data[[1]] %>% mutate(library = "brunello") 
jacquere_library_and_lfc_data[[1]] <- jacquere_library_and_lfc_data[[1]] %>% mutate(library = "jacquere") 

```

# Calculate effect size of multi-target/single-mismatch sgRNA

```{r}

calculate_wilcoxon_cliff(jacquere_library_and_lfc_data, "pam-distal single mismatch")

```

# Bind every library into one single plot of sgRNA Log2FC

```{r}
source("./00_CRISPR-KO-library-survey-functions.R")

combined_data <- rbind(avana_library_and_lfc_data[[1]], 
                       tkov3_library_and_lfc_data[[1]], 
                       yusa_library_and_lfc_data[[1]], 
                       brunello_library_and_lfc_data[[1]], 
                       jacquere_library_and_lfc_data[[1]])

combined_data <- combined_data %>% mutate(library = factor(library, levels = c("brunello", "toronto_v3", "yusa", "avana", "jacquere")))


visualize_two_group(combined_data, 
                    "../figure/03_fig_analysis_lfc_off-target-sgrna/combined_library_pam_distal_single_mismatch.png",
                    "pam-distal single mismatch",
                    "PAM-distal single mismatch guides")

```

# Generate plot of stratification multi-target sgRNAs

```{r}

visualize_stratify_alignment(avana_library_and_lfc_data[[2]], "number of PAM-distal single mismatch \noff-target alignment", "../figure/03_fig_analysis_lfc_off-target-sgrna/avana_pam_distal_single_mismatch.png")
visualize_stratify_alignment(tkov3_library_and_lfc_data[[2]], "number of PAM-distal single mismatch \noff-target alignment", "../figure/03_fig_analysis_lfc_off-target-sgrna/tkov3_pam_distal_single_mismatch.png")
visualize_stratify_alignment(brunello_library_and_lfc_data[[2]], "number of PAM-distal single mismatch \noff-target alignment", "../figure/03_fig_analysis_lfc_off-target-sgrna/brunello_pam_distal_single_mismatch.png")
visualize_stratify_alignment(yusa_library_and_lfc_data[[2]], "number of PAM-distal single mismatch \noff-target alignment", "../figure/03_fig_analysis_lfc_off-target-sgrna/yusa_pam_distal_single_mismatch.png")
visualize_stratify_alignment(jacquere_library_and_lfc_data[[2]], "number of PAM-distal single mismatch \noff-target alignment", "../figure/03_fig_analysis_lfc_off-target-sgrna/jacquere_pam_distal_single_mismatch.png")
```
